newsitem.title: USA: Meditrust Healthcare to issue debt.
newsitem.headline: Meditrust Healthcare to issue debt.

text.p: Meditrust Healthcare Inc is expected to tap the corporate bond primary market with a $400 million three-part debt offering this week, dealers said on Monday.
The Baa3/BBB-minus rated offering, which is expected to price on Wednesday, will include five-year, seven-year and 10-year maturities, dealers said.

Merrill Lynch will be the lead manager for all tranches; however, other underewriters on the 10-year tranche will include JP Morgan Securities, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Salomon Brothers and Smith Barney, dealers said.
(( -- Nancy Leinfuss, U.S. corporate bond unit,
